mentions.h: Centenary Cup awarded to Jennifer Culley
mentions.note: won Centenary Cup 1999; unbeaten in Women's Southern League; 400m hurdles club record 55.2 at Hastings; 2nd County 400m; represented Surrey at CGU Inter-Counties

born 4.3.75 (as printed); 100 metres 12.5 (Hayes 24Jun); 200 metres 26.0 (Salisbury 15Jul); 400 metres 56.02 (Birmingham 12Aug); 4x100 metres Relay 51.9 team (Basingstoke 11Jun); 4x400 metres Relay 4:25.0 team (Hayes 24Jun)

official.h: 2003 - A critical year for the Belles

photos.c: It's relay time in the Southern League and Jennifer runs another one lap stormer.
Top left: Jennifer Culley takes the baton from Hannah Stares to run the last leg of the 4 x 400 metres and bring the Belles home to another win.

Above: At the home UKWAL match at Sutton the Belles just missed stretching their win streak to cover two complete seasons.  Another four match points would have done it – but they don’t seem too downhearted as they now look forward to 2007 and UKWAL Division Two.

From left to right – standing: Juliet Fielden, Katryna Euridge, Eva Massey, John Vernon, Sarah Gailey, Jayne Anderson, Chris Privett, Claire Robinson, Bob Bridges (Joint Team Manager), Cynthia James (Joint Team Manager), Rex Bale, Carl Lawton, Jennifer Culley, Tony Fairclough, Sarah Murphy, Derek Jones, Ray James. Kneeling: Sarah Wellstead, Janine Whitlock, Gail Porter, Dian Holden, Hazel Mead.
